plugins.name: cj-tauri-skills
plugins.description: AtomCode skills for the cj-tauri framework (Cangjie + system WebView): app development workflow (scaffold / commands / plugins / frontend), real-device verification & evidence gathering, a field-tested pitfall quick reference, and a contribute-back loop that turns new pitfalls into PRs. Install once and any AtomCode agent can build apps with cj-tauri.
